prompts.title: 间谍惊悚喜剧故事板提示
prompts.description: 一个叙事提示，旨在为一部喜剧间谍惊悚片场景生成多格分镜脚本，内容涉及战术特工监视一位只想在冰箱里找牛奶的郊区父亲。
prompts.content:
Early morning. Total silence.

A hyper-serious spy thriller vibe.

A sleek black SUV idles outside a quiet suburban house. Two “tactical” men in earpieces whisper intensely.

“Target is inside.”
“Movement in the kitchen.”
“Stand by.”
Inside the house—
A dad in sweatpants stands in front of the fridge, staring into it like it contains classified secrets.

Cut back outside.

“Subject has opened the cold storage unit.”
“Thermal spike detected.”

Inside, he pulls out milk. Shakes it. Sniffs it. Makes a face.

Outside, one agent squints at a tablet.
“He’s analyzing chemical integrity.”
The front door creaks open.

The dad steps onto the porch in mismatched slippers to grab the newspaper.

Both agents snap alert.
“Target exiting the compound.”
“Visual confirmed. He looks… unstable.”
The dad waves awkwardly at them.

They freeze.

He squints. “You guys DoorDash?”

Beat.
They look at each other.
Inside the SUV, a third “commander” barks through the radio:
“Abort. Wrong house. Again.”

The agents slowly lower their sunglasses.

The dad shrugs, walks back inside.

Cut to kitchen.

He sits at the table with his cereal. Turns on the TV.

BREAKING NEWS: “International spy ring apprehended after staking out random suburban dad for third straight day.”

He crunches loudly.
Milk drips down his chin.

He sighs.

“Finally.”
prompts.translatedContent:
清晨。万籁俱寂。

弥漫着一股极度严肃的谍战片氛围。

一辆锃亮的黑色 SUV 停在一栋安静的郊区房屋外，引擎怠速运转。两名戴着耳机的“特工”正低声紧张地交谈着。

“目标在里面。”
“厨房有动静。”
“待命。”
屋内——
一位穿着运动裤的父亲站在冰箱前，凝视着冰箱内部，仿佛里面藏着绝密情报。

镜头切回屋外。

“目标已打开冷藏装置。”
“检测到热量峰值。”

屋内，他拿出牛奶。摇了摇。闻了闻。做了一个鬼脸。

屋外，一名特工眯着眼睛盯着平板电脑。
“他正在分析化学完整性。”
前门吱呀一声打开了。

这位父亲穿着不配套的拖鞋走到门廊上，去拿报纸。

两名特工立刻警觉起来。
“目标正在离开住所。”
“目视确认。他看起来……不太稳定。”
这位父亲笨拙地冲他们挥了挥手。

他们僵住了。

他眯着眼睛。“你们是 DoorDash 的吗？”

（沉默）
他们面面相觑。
SUV 里，第三位“指挥官”通过无线电吼道：
“撤退。又搞错房子了。”

特工们缓缓摘下墨镜。

这位父亲耸了耸肩，走回屋内。

镜头切到厨房。

他坐在餐桌旁吃着麦片。打开电视。

突发新闻：“国际间谍组织在连续三天监视一名随机郊区父亲后被捕。”

他大声嚼着麦片。
牛奶顺着下巴滴落。

他叹了口气。

“终于。”

prompts.title: 超现实零重力爆炸肖像
prompts.description: 一个高度技术性的提示，用于生成一张超现实主义摄影作品：主体（伊丽莎白·奥尔森）站在一个复古泳池小屋内，周围是数百件夏季物品在失重状态下爆炸形成的混乱场景。提示中详细说明了相机设备、胶片类型、灯光和构图（眩晕式倾斜角度）。
prompts.content: A photographic surrealist shot of The Protagonist, appearing as a detached observer, standing amidst a chaotic zero-gravity explosion inside a cluttered vintage poolside cabana. The subject wears a high-fashion, textured swimwear piece. The environment is densely packed with hundreds of summer artifacts frozen in mid-air: melting ice cream cones, retro sunglasses, striped towels, splashes of chlorinated water, and inflatable beach balls, all suspended as if time has stopped. The lighting is a mix of harsh, directional sunlight casting sharp, long shadows across the floating debris, combined with a cool-toned, ghostly fill light. The composition utilizes a severe Vertigo Dutch Angle (25-degree tilt) to induce disorientation. Shot on a Hasselblad H6D-100c with a wide 35mm lens, high aperture (f/11) to keep the dense clutter in focus, processed with the grain and color shift of Kodak Ektachrome E100 film. Hyper-realistic textures, practical effect aesthetic, no CGI feel.
prompts.translatedContent: 一张超现实主义摄影作品，主角仿佛一个超然的观察者，置身于一个杂乱的复古泳池小屋内，周围是失重状态下的混乱爆炸。主体身着一件高级定制的纹理泳装。环境中密密麻麻地悬浮着数百件凝固在半空中的夏日物品：融化的冰淇淋筒、复古太阳镜、条纹毛巾、飞溅的氯化水花和充气沙滩球，仿佛时间静止了一般。光线是刺眼的直射阳光，在漂浮的碎片上投射出锐利而狭长的阴影，并辅以冷色调、幽灵般的补光。构图采用极端的眩晕式倾斜角度（25 度倾斜），以制造迷失方向感。使用哈苏 H6D-100c 相机，搭配广角 35mm 镜头拍摄，高光圈（f/11）以确保密集杂物清晰对焦，并经过柯达 Ektachrome E100 胶片的颗粒感和色彩偏移处理。呈现超现实的纹理，具有实用效果美学，无 CGI 感。

prompts.title: 电影级办公室肖像
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成一张垂直、电影感、超写实的女性肖像，背景设定在一个狭窄的办公室复印室里。提示中详细说明了她的服装（纽扣衬衫、迷你裙、透明连裤袜）、姿势、环境，以及带有冷绿色调阴影的忧郁复古胶片调色。
prompts.content:
Create a vertical cinematic photorealistic portrait with subtle retro film grading and a moody, voyeuristic office atmosphere.

A young adult woman stands in a narrow office copy room, leaning back against a large multifunction photocopier positioned slightly to the right. She crosses her legs at the ankles and folds her arms across her chest, looking directly at the camera with a calm, slightly distant expression. She has straight, shoulder-length black hair with full bangs. She wears a fitted white button-up blouse, a striped ribbon bow tie, a high-waisted dark mini skirt, and sheer black pantyhose. Fabrics appear realistic: matte cotton blouse, structured skirt, translucent nylon stockings.

The environment includes light-colored walls, a wall poster with Japanese text, and partially visible shelving. The copier shows realistic plastic and metal textures. The space feels tight and enclosed.

Frame the shot at eye level in a medium full-body composition. Shoot through a narrow foreground gap, with dark blurred vertical shapes on both sides forming a natural vignette. Keep the subject sharply focused, especially her face and upper torso, with shallow depth of field and softly blurred background.

Use soft diffused indoor overhead lighting with slight frontal illumination, moderate contrast, and gentle shadows. Apply cool greenish-teal shadows with warm skin tones, slightly desaturated colors (muted teal, beige, off-white, charcoal, deep black). Add subtle fine film grain and balanced dynamic range to maintain an intimate, slightly nostalgic cinematic realism.
prompts.translatedContent:
创作一张垂直的电影级写实肖像，带有一丝复古胶片颗粒感和一种忧郁、窥视感的办公室氛围。

一名年轻女子站在狭窄的办公室复印室里，背靠着一台大型多功能复印机，复印机略微偏右。她双腿交叉，双手抱胸，平静而略带疏离地直视镜头。她留着齐肩的黑色直发，有齐刘海。她穿着一件修身的白色纽扣衬衫、一条条纹领结、一条高腰深色迷你裙和透明的黑色连裤袜。面料质感逼真：哑光棉衬衫、有型的裙子、半透明尼龙丝袜。

环境包括浅色墙壁、一张带有日文文字的墙上海报和部分可见的置物架。复印机呈现出逼真的塑料和金属质感。空间感觉狭窄而封闭。

镜头构图为中等全身像，与视线齐平。透过狭窄的前景间隙拍摄，两侧有深色模糊的垂直形状，形成自然的渐晕效果。主体保持清晰对焦，尤其是她的脸部和上半身，景深较浅，背景柔和模糊。

使用柔和漫射的室内顶灯，略带正面照明，中等对比度，柔和阴影。应用冷绿色调的阴影和暖色调的肤色，色彩略微去饱和（柔和的青色、米色、米白色、炭灰色、深黑色）。添加细微的胶片颗粒感和平衡的动态范围，以保持一种亲密、略带怀旧的电影写实感。
